entries.label: WE_ARE0
entries.body:
Attention starship!
We are the Zoq-Fot-Pik.
entries.source:
Attention starship!
We are the Zoq-Fot-Pik.
entries.translation:
星艦注意！
我們是佐克－福特－皮克。

entries.label: WE_ARE1
entries.body: Make no hostile actions!
entries.source: Make no hostile actions!
entries.translation: 不准採取敵對行動！

entries.label: WE_ARE2
entries.body: We come in peace, and with good will.
entries.source: We come in peace, and with good will.
entries.translation: 我們為和平而來， 並懷有善意。

entries.label: WE_ARE3
entries.body: But if you make one false move, you're vapor!
entries.source: But if you make one false move, you're vapor!
entries.translation: 但你只要動歪腦筋， 就會化成蒸氣！

entries.label: WE_ARE4
entries.body: Don't worry, my companion is just a bit nervous...
entries.source: Don't worry, my companion is just a bit nervous...
entries.translation: 別擔心，我的同伴只是有點 緊張……

entries.label: WE_ARE5
entries.body: No, I'm not!
entries.source: No, I'm not!
entries.translation: 我才沒有！

entries.label: WE_ARE6
entries.body: ...and argumentative.
entries.source: ...and argumentative.
entries.translation: ……而且愛抬槓。

entries.label: WE_ARE7
entries.body: No, I'm not.
entries.source: No, I'm not.
entries.translation: 我才沒有。

entries.label: SCOUT_HELLO0
entries.body:
We are a scout vessel
dispatched from our homeworld.
entries.source:
We are a scout vessel
dispatched from our homeworld.
entries.translation:
我們是一艘偵察船
由母星派遣而來。

entries.label: SCOUT_HELLO1
entries.body:
We have travelled far
through hostile, uncharted space
to find you.
We hail from the green dwarf star at coordinates
ziggerfau-gerrrnuf, Ah-ah, Pahoy-hoy.
entries.source:
We have travelled far
through hostile, uncharted space
to find you.
We hail from the green dwarf star at coordinates
ziggerfau-gerrrnuf, Ah-ah, Pahoy-hoy.
entries.translation:
我們長途跋涉
穿越充滿敵意、 未經測繪的太空
只為找到你們。
我們來自座標為以下位置的 綠色矮星
ziggerfau-ge rrrnuf、 Ah-ah、Pahoy- hoy。

entries.label: SCOUT_HELLO2
entries.body: No, you idiot, in their coordinate system!
entries.source: No, you idiot, in their coordinate system!
entries.translation: 不對，你這蠢蛋， 要用他們的座標系統！

entries.label: SCOUT_HELLO3
entries.body:
Oh! Er
Coordinates 400.0 : 543.7.
entries.source:
Oh! Er
Coordinates 400.0 : 543.7.

entries.label: INIT_HOME_HELLO0
entries.body: You have arrived at our homeworld.
entries.source: You have arrived at our homeworld.
entries.translation: 你們已抵達我們的母星。

entries.label: INIT_HOME_HELLO1
entries.body: And we've got a billion ships here!
entries.source: And we've got a billion ships here!
entries.translation: 而且我們這裡有十億艘船！

entries.label: INIT_HOME_HELLO2
entries.body: We are fortunate that you have found us in our time of need.
entries.source: We are fortunate that you have found us in our time of need.
entries.translation: 你們在我們需要援助之際找 到這裡，實在幸運。

entries.label: INIT_HOME_HELLO3
entries.body: So don't even think of trying to attack us!
entries.source: So don't even think of trying to attack us!
entries.translation: 所以連想都別想攻擊我們！

entries.label: which_fot
entries.body: Which one of you creatures is the Fot?
entries.source: Which one of you creatures is the Fot?
entries.translation: 你們這些生物裡， 哪一個是福特？

entries.label: HE_IS0
entries.body: He is.
entries.source: He is.
entries.translation: 是他。

entries.label: HE_IS1
entries.body: No, she is!
entries.source: No, she is!
entries.translation: 不，是她！

entries.label: HE_IS2
entries.body: No, I'm not!
entries.source: No, I'm not!
entries.translation: 我才不是！

entries.label: HE_IS3
entries.body: Yes, you are.
entries.source: Yes, you are.
entries.translation: 你就是。

entries.label: HE_IS4
entries.body: Cripes! We've been through this a million times!
entries.source: Cripes! We've been through this a million times!
entries.translation: 老天！這件事都講過一百萬 次了！

entries.label: HE_IS5
entries.body: That doesn't change anything. You're the Fot!
entries.source: That doesn't change anything. You're the Fot!
entries.translation: 那又改變不了什麼。 你就是福特！

entries.label: HE_IS6
entries.body:
Faugh!
Well, Captain, as you can see, this is a point of some contention.
entries.source:
Faugh!
Well, Captain, as you can see, this is a point of some contention.
entries.translation:
呸！
艦長，你也看見了， 這件事頗有爭議。

entries.label: HE_IS7
entries.body: Fot!
entries.source: Fot!
entries.translation: 福特！

entries.label: we_are_vindicator0
entries.body: We are
entries.source: We are
entries.translation: 我們是

entries.label: we_are_vindicator1
entries.body: flagship
entries.source: flagship
entries.translation: 的旗艦

entries.label: we_are_vindicator2
entries.body: from Earth.  What are your intentions?
entries.source: from Earth.  What are your intentions?
entries.translation: ，來自地球。  你們有何意圖？

entries.label: WE_GLAD0
entries.body:
Hurrah!
Then we've finally found our saviors!
entries.source:
Hurrah!
Then we've finally found our saviors!
entries.translation:
萬歲！
那我們終於找到救星了！

entries.label: WE_GLAD1
entries.body: Maybe.
entries.source: Maybe.
entries.translation: 也許吧。

entries.label: WE_GLAD2
entries.body:
At last, our search is over!
It is just as the great Crystal ones promised!
entries.source:
At last, our search is over!
It is just as the great Crystal ones promised!
entries.translation:
我們的搜索終於結束了！
一切正如偉大水晶族所承諾 的！

entries.label: WE_GLAD3
entries.body:
They look sneaky.
I think they're lying.
entries.source:
They look sneaky.
I think they're lying.
entries.translation:
他們看起來鬼鬼祟祟。
我覺得他們在說謊。

entries.label: WE_GLAD4
entries.body:
Quiet, fool!
Can't you see our nightmare is over!?
This ship is from the Great Crystal One's fabled Alliance
the Alliance of Free Stars!
entries.source:
Quiet, fool!
Can't you see our nightmare is over!?
This ship is from the Great Crystal One's fabled Alliance
the Alliance of Free Stars!
entries.translation:
安靜，蠢蛋！
你沒看出我們的惡夢已經結 束了嗎！？
這艘船來自偉大水晶族傳說 中的聯盟
自由星辰聯盟！

entries.label: WE_GLAD5
entries.body: Maybe.
entries.source: Maybe.
entries.translation: 也許吧。

entries.label: quiet_toadies
entries.body: SILENCE BLATHERING TOADIES! We are your new masters.
entries.source: SILENCE BLATHERING TOADIES! We are your new masters.
entries.translation: 滿口廢話的馬屁精，安靜！ 我們是你們的新主人。

entries.label: TOLD_YOU0
entries.body: We are disappointed.
entries.source: We are disappointed.
entries.translation: 我們很失望。

entries.label: TOLD_YOU1
entries.body: See! I TOLD you!
entries.source: See! I TOLD you!
entries.translation: 看吧！我就說嘛！

entries.label: TOLD_YOU2
entries.body: We had hoped that our species could be friends.
entries.source: We had hoped that our species could be friends.
entries.translation: 我們原本希望彼此的物種能 成為朋友。

entries.label: TOLD_YOU3
entries.body: Never in a million years! Just look at their beady eyes!
entries.source: Never in a million years! Just look at their beady eyes!
entries.translation: 再等一百萬年也不可能！ 看看他們那雙賊溜溜的小眼 睛！

entries.label: TOLD_YOU4
entries.body: But in the spirit of understanding...
entries.source: But in the spirit of understanding...
entries.translation: 不過，本著互相理解的精 神……

entries.label: TOLD_YOU5
entries.body: Oh, no! You're not even considering...
entries.source: Oh, no! You're not even considering...
entries.translation: 喔，不！你該不會在考 慮……

entries.label: TOLD_YOU6
entries.body: ...We will forgive you this transgression.
entries.source: ...We will forgive you this transgression.
entries.translation: ……我們願意原諒你這次冒 犯。

entries.label: TOLD_YOU7
entries.body: Sheesh! What a pushover you are!
entries.source: Sheesh! What a pushover you are!
entries.translation: 真是的！你也太好欺負了 吧！

entries.label: your_race
entries.body: Before we go on, can you tell us more about your species?
entries.source: Before we go on, can you tell us more about your species?
entries.translation: 在繼續以前，可以再多談談 你們的物種嗎？

entries.label: YEARS_AGO0
entries.body: In our ancient past, four species evolved intelligence on our homeworld.
entries.source: In our ancient past, four species evolved intelligence on our homeworld.
entries.translation: 在遠古時期，母星上有四個 物種演化出智慧。

entries.label: YEARS_AGO1
entries.body: Simultaneously.
entries.source: Simultaneously.
entries.translation: 而且是同時。

entries.label: YEARS_AGO2
entries.body: They were the Zoq...
entries.source: They were the Zoq...
entries.translation: 他們分別是佐克……

entries.label: YEARS_AGO3
entries.body: ...the Fot...
entries.source: ...the Fot...

entries.label: YEARS_AGO4
entries.body: ...the Pik...
entries.source: ...the Pik...

entries.label: YEARS_AGO5
entries.body: ...and the Zebranky.
entries.source: ...and the Zebranky.
entries.translation: ……還有澤布蘭基。

entries.label: YEARS_AGO6
entries.body:
We three, the Zoq, Fot, and Pik evolved in such a way
as to acquire sustenance from many sources...
entries.source:
We three, the Zoq, Fot, and Pik evolved in such a way
as to acquire sustenance from many sources...
entries.translation:
我們三族，也就是佐克、 福特和皮克，演化出從多種 來源
取得養分的能力……

entries.label: YEARS_AGO7
entries.body: ...from airborne zooplankton...
entries.source: ...from airborne zooplankton...
entries.translation: ……從空中的浮游動物……

entries.label: YEARS_AGO8
entries.body: ...from solar and ambient energies...
entries.source: ...from solar and ambient energies...
entries.translation: ……從太陽能與環境能 量……

entries.label: YEARS_AGO9
entries.body: ...and from rocky fungal clingers.
entries.source: ...and from rocky fungal clingers.
entries.translation: ……以及附著岩石的真菌。

entries.label: YEARS_AGO10
entries.body: Our favorite!
entries.source: Our favorite!
entries.translation: 那是我們的最愛！

entries.label: YEARS_AGO11
entries.body:
The Zebranky also consumed a variety of foods
namely: the Zoq
the Fot
and the Pik.
entries.source:
The Zebranky also consumed a variety of foods
namely: the Zoq
the Fot
and the Pik.
entries.translation:
澤布蘭基也吃很多種食物
也就是：佐克
福特
以及皮克。

entries.label: YEARS_AGO12
entries.body:
To survive the predations of the Zebranky
we banded together
annihilated the Zebranky...
entries.source:
To survive the predations of the Zebranky
we banded together
annihilated the Zebranky...
entries.translation:
為了在澤布蘭基的捕食下存 活
我們團結起來
消滅了澤布蘭基……

entries.label: YEARS_AGO13
entries.body: ...and formed the cooperative union you now encounter.
entries.source: ...and formed the cooperative union you now encounter.
entries.translation: ……並組成你們現在見到的 合作聯盟。

entries.label: where_from
entries.body: What do you seek from us?
entries.source: What do you seek from us?
entries.translation: 你們想從我們這裡尋求什 麼？

entries.label: TRAVELED_FAR0
entries.body: We are a relatively peaceful group of species.
entries.source: We are a relatively peaceful group of species.
entries.translation: 我們是相對和平的一群物 種。

entries.label: TRAVELED_FAR1
entries.body: Unless we're angry.
entries.source: Unless we're angry.
entries.translation: 除非我們生氣了。

entries.label: TRAVELED_FAR2
entries.body: So we find ourselves in need of help.
entries.source: So we find ourselves in need of help.
entries.translation: 因此我們現在需要援助。

entries.label: TRAVELED_FAR3
entries.body: We only need a LITTLE!
entries.source: We only need a LITTLE!
entries.translation: 只需要一點點！

entries.label: TRAVELED_FAR4
entries.body: Because of our desperate situation.
entries.source: Because of our desperate situation.
entries.translation: 因為我們的處境十分危急。

entries.label: TRAVELED_FAR5
entries.body:
`Desperate' is too strong a word.
I think `troublesome' is more like it.
entries.source:
`Desperate' is too strong a word.
I think `troublesome' is more like it.
entries.translation:
「危急」這個詞太嚴重了。
我覺得「麻煩」比較貼切。

entries.label: what_emergency
entries.body: What `nightmare' are you talking about? What's the matter?
entries.source: What `nightmare' are you talking about? What's the matter?
entries.translation: 你們說的「惡夢」是什麼？ 出了什麼問題？

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK0
entries.body: Our planets are under attack from an invading horde!
entries.source: Our planets are under attack from an invading horde!
entries.translation: 我們的行星正遭到侵略大軍 攻擊！

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK1
entries.body: We do not know who they are, or why they are here.
entries.source: We do not know who they are, or why they are here.
entries.translation: 我們不知道他們是誰， 也不知道為何而來。

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK2
entries.body: We are being blown to bits.
entries.source: We are being blown to bits.
entries.translation: 我們被炸得粉身碎骨。

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK3
entries.body:
Fleets of alien ships appear out of nowhere
then unleash terrible destructive energies.
entries.source:
Fleets of alien ships appear out of nowhere
then unleash terrible destructive energies.
entries.translation:
外星艦隊憑空出現
接著釋放破壞力駭人的能 量。

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK4
entries.body: Fortunately...
entries.source: Fortunately...
entries.translation: 幸運的是……

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK5
entries.body: ...they release these energies on each other.
entries.source: ...they release these energies on each other.
entries.translation: ……他們把這些能量用在彼 此身上。

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK6
entries.body: Unfortunately...
entries.source: Unfortunately...
entries.translation: 不幸的是……

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK7
entries.body:
...they favor combat near strong gravity wells.
Their stray shots regularly strike the surface of our planets
often with tragic results.
entries.source:
...they favor combat near strong gravity wells.
Their stray shots regularly strike the surface of our planets
often with tragic results.
entries.translation:
……他們偏愛在強大重力井 附近戰鬥。
流彈經常擊中我方行星地表
往往釀成悲劇。

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK8
entries.body: Fortunately...
entries.source: Fortunately...
entries.translation: 幸運的是……

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK9
entries.body: ...they have never found our homeworld, only our colony planets.
entries.source: ...they have never found our homeworld, only our colony planets.
entries.translation: ……他們從未發現我們的母 星，只有殖民行星。

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK10
entries.body: Unfortunately...
entries.source: Unfortunately...
entries.translation: 不幸的是……

entries.label: UNDER_ATTACK11
entries.body: ...all of our colonies have perished as a consequence.
entries.source: ...all of our colonies have perished as a consequence.
entries.translation: ……因此我們所有的殖民地 都滅亡了。

entries.label: tough_luck
entries.body: Hey, space is a tough place where wimps eat flaming plasma death.
entries.source: Hey, space is a tough place where wimps eat flaming plasma death.
entries.translation: 嘿，太空就是個弱雞吞下燃 燒電漿、死無全屍的險惡地 方。

entries.label: NOT_HELPFUL0
entries.body: Oh, dear.
entries.source: Oh, dear.
entries.translation: 喔，天啊。

entries.label: NOT_HELPFUL1
entries.body: I told you he looked like a creep!
entries.source: I told you he looked like a creep!
entries.translation: 我就說他看起來像個混蛋！

entries.label: NOT_HELPFUL2
entries.body:
No! We must try to understand.
His ways are not like our own.
entries.source:
No! We must try to understand.
His ways are not like our own.
entries.translation:
不！我們必須嘗試理解。
他的行事方式與我們不同。

entries.label: NOT_HELPFUL3
entries.body: You mean his WHOLE SPECIES are jerks?
entries.source: You mean his WHOLE SPECIES are jerks?
entries.translation: 你是說他們整個物種都是混 帳嗎？

entries.label: NOT_HELPFUL4
entries.body: Let us give him one more chance.
entries.source: Let us give him one more chance.
entries.translation: 讓我們再給他一次機會。

entries.label: NOT_HELPFUL5
entries.body: Just look at him! He's a killer, I tell you!
entries.source: Just look at him! He's a killer, I tell you!
entries.translation: 瞧瞧他的樣子！我跟你說， 他就是個殺手！

entries.label: what_look_like
entries.body: Who is attacking you? What do they look like?
entries.source: Who is attacking you? What do they look like?
entries.translation: 誰在攻擊你們？ 他們長什麼樣子？

entries.label: LOOK_LIKE0
entries.body:
Some of the vessels are huge, green battleships
which launch wave after wave of small fighters.
entries.source:
Some of the vessels are huge, green battleships
which launch wave after wave of small fighters.
entries.translation:
有些船艦是巨大的綠色戰艦
會發射一波又一波的小型戰 機。

entries.label: LOOK_LIKE1
entries.body:
The other ships are black as space
and their hulls are carved with strange alien writing.
entries.source:
The other ships are black as space
and their hulls are carved with strange alien writing.
entries.translation:
另一種船艦和太空一樣漆黑
船殼上刻著奇怪的外星文 字。

entries.label: LOOK_LIKE2
entries.body: In combat the two ships seem evenly matched.
entries.source: In combat the two ships seem evenly matched.
entries.translation: 這兩種船艦交戰時似乎勢均 力敵。

entries.label: LOOK_LIKE3
entries.body:
One fires blasts of fusion energy
while the other launches spinning projectiles.
entries.source:
One fires blasts of fusion energy
while the other launches spinning projectiles.
entries.translation:
一方發射核融合能量束
另一方則發射旋轉投射物。

entries.label: valuable_info
entries.body: You have given us valuable information. Goodbye.
entries.source: You have given us valuable information. Goodbye.
entries.translation: 你們提供了寶貴資訊。 再見。

entries.label: GOODBYE0
entries.body: If you must go now, we understand.
entries.source: If you must go now, we understand.
entries.translation: 如果你們現在非走不可， 我們能理解。

entries.label: GOODBYE1
entries.body: That's it?! You're leaving?!!
entries.source: That's it?! You're leaving?!!
entries.translation: 就這樣？！你們要走 了？！！

entries.label: GOODBYE2
entries.body:
We hope that on your next visit
we can establish a mutual assistance pact.
entries.source:
We hope that on your next visit
we can establish a mutual assistance pact.
entries.translation:
希望下次來訪時
我們能締結互助協定。

entries.label: GOODBYE3
entries.body:
I can't believe that he's just leaving us here!
...what a jerk.
entries.source:
I can't believe that he's just leaving us here!
...what a jerk.
entries.translation:
真不敢相信他就這樣把我們 丟在這裡！
……混蛋。

entries.label: all_very_interesting
entries.body: Yes, yes, that's all very interesting, but now we are going to attack you!
entries.source: Yes, yes, that's all very interesting, but now we are going to attack you!
entries.translation: 好、好，這些都很有意思， 但我們現在要攻擊你們了！

entries.label: SEE_TOLD_YOU0
entries.body: What?
entries.source: What?
entries.translation: 什麼？

entries.label: SEE_TOLD_YOU1
entries.body:
See! I told you.!...
...but would you listen... NO!
entries.source:
See! I told you.!...
...but would you listen... NO!
entries.translation:
看吧！我早就說過！……
……可是你聽了嗎…… 沒有！

entries.label: SEE_TOLD_YOU2
entries.body: I don't understand!
entries.source: I don't understand!
entries.translation: 我不明白！

entries.label: SEE_TOLD_YOU3
entries.body:
So what does all your nicey-nice to the alien get us?
Nothing! That's what!
You should have done what I said
and told him we were the Precursors.
entries.source:
So what does all your nicey-nice to the alien get us?
Nothing! That's what!
You should have done what I said
and told him we were the Precursors.
entries.translation:
你對外星人好聲好氣， 到底為我們換來什麼？
什麼都沒有！就是這樣！
你早該照我說的做
告訴他我們就是先驅者。

entries.label: how_can_i_help
entries.body: We want to help. What can we do?
entries.source: We want to help. What can we do?
entries.translation: 我們想幫忙。能做些什麼？

entries.label: ALLY_WITH_US0
entries.body:
We would like to establish
a formal mutual-assistance pact
with your species.
entries.source:
We would like to establish
a formal mutual-assistance pact
with your species.
entries.translation:
我們想與你們的物種
締結一項正式的
互助協定。

entries.label: ALLY_WITH_US1
entries.body:
One of those `You scratch my vent
I'll scratch your flipper' set-ups.
entries.source:
One of those `You scratch my vent
I'll scratch your flipper' set-ups.
entries.translation:
就是那種「你搔我的通氣孔
我搔你的鰭」的安排。

entries.label: ALLY_WITH_US2
entries.body:
And as a sign of our good faith
we will provide you with skilled Captains
and plans for building our `Stinger' starships.
entries.source:
And as a sign of our good faith
we will provide you with skilled Captains
and plans for building our `Stinger' starships.
entries.translation:
為了展現誠意
我們會提供技術純熟的艦長
以及建造毒刺艦的設計圖。

entries.label: ALLY_WITH_US3
entries.body:
In return, if the bad guys find our homeworld
you'll rush over here and vaporize 'em.
entries.source:
In return, if the bad guys find our homeworld
you'll rush over here and vaporize 'em.
entries.translation:
相對地，如果壞蛋找到我們 的母星
你們就馬上衝來把他們化成 蒸氣。

entries.label: ALLY_WITH_US4
entries.body: That is, essentially, correct.
entries.source: That is, essentially, correct.
entries.translation: 基本上沒錯。

entries.label: ALLY_WITH_US5
entries.body:
Great deal, eh?
You can't afford to pass it up!
So what do you say?
entries.source:
Great deal, eh?
You can't afford to pass it up!
So what do you say?
entries.translation:
很划算吧？
你絕對不能錯過！
所以你們怎麼說？

entries.label: decide_later
entries.body: Uh... I need to consult with our, er... our Grand-High Poobah!
entries.source: Uh... I need to consult with our, er... our Grand-High Poobah!
entries.translation: 呃……我得請示我們的， 呃……至高大人物！

entries.label: PLEASE_HURRY0
entries.body:
Please hurry back with word from your Poobah.
Millions of lives are at stake!
entries.source:
Please hurry back with word from your Poobah.
Millions of lives are at stake!
entries.translation:
請儘快帶著大人物的答覆回 來。
數百萬條生命危在旦夕！

entries.label: PLEASE_HURRY1
entries.body: Not the least of which is mine.
entries.source: Not the least of which is mine.
entries.translation: 尤其包括我這一條。

entries.label: EMMISSARIES0
entries.body: These are the words we have prayed for!
entries.source: These are the words we have prayed for!
entries.translation: 這正是我們祈求已久的答 覆！

entries.label: EMMISSARIES1
entries.body: Hey! This trip's not a waste after all!
entries.source: Hey! This trip's not a waste after all!
entries.translation: 嘿！這趟旅程總算沒白跑！

entries.label: EMMISSARIES2
entries.body:
More than anything, we seek an ally
to help us survive in this hostile universe.
entries.source:
More than anything, we seek an ally
to help us survive in this hostile universe.
entries.translation:
我們最渴望的， 就是一位盟友
幫助我們在這個充滿敵意的 宇宙中存活。

entries.label: EMMISSARIES3
entries.body: We are having some problems of that general nature.
entries.source: We are having some problems of that general nature.
entries.translation: 我們確實遇到了一些大致屬 於這類的問題。

entries.label: EMMISSARIES4
entries.body:
But we are only emissaries.
You must meet with our leaders.
They are wiser... more powerful beings!
entries.source:
But we are only emissaries.
You must meet with our leaders.
They are wiser... more powerful beings!
entries.translation:
但我們只是使者。
你必須與我們的領袖會面。
他們更加睿智…… 也是更強大的存在！

entries.label: EMMISSARIES5
entries.body: They look just like us, though.
entries.source: They look just like us, though.
entries.translation: 不過長得跟我們一模一樣。

entries.label: EMMISSARIES6
entries.body:
Fly to the star called Alpha Tucanae.
The planet closest to the sun is our home.
entries.source:
Fly to the star called Alpha Tucanae.
The planet closest to the sun is our home.
entries.translation:
請飛往名為 Alpha Tucanae 的恆星。
最靠近太陽的行星就是我們 的家園。

entries.label: EMMISSARIES7
entries.body: And if possible, hurry.
entries.source: And if possible, hurry.
entries.translation: 可以的話，請快一點。

entries.label: sure
entries.body: You are under attack by the Ur-Quan, our enemy as well.  Therefore, speaking for all the People of Earth, I accept your offer.
entries.source: You are under attack by the Ur-Quan, our enemy as well.  Therefore, speaking for all the People of Earth, I accept your offer.
entries.translation: 攻擊你們的烏爾關也是我們 的敵人。因此， 我代表全體地球人民接受你 們的提議。

entries.label: WE_ALLY0
entries.body: How wonderful!
entries.source: How wonderful!
entries.translation: 太美好了！

entries.label: WE_ALLY1
entries.body: Hurray!
entries.source: Hurray!
entries.translation: 萬歲！

entries.label: WE_ALLY2
entries.body: How marvelous!
entries.source: How marvelous!
entries.translation: 真是太棒了！

entries.label: WE_ALLY3
entries.body: Yee-ha!
entries.source: Yee-ha!
entries.translation: 耶－哈！

entries.label: WE_ALLY4
entries.body:
Captain, we shall begin fulfilling our commitment at once!
We will begin transporting our officers to your base immediately!
entries.source:
Captain, we shall begin fulfilling our commitment at once!
We will begin transporting our officers to your base immediately!
entries.translation:
艦長，我們會立刻開始履行 承諾！
馬上把軍官送往你們的基 地！

entries.label: WE_ALLY5
entries.body:
Why, heck!
Maybe I'll even make the trip to your planet!
I'd make a good starship captain, Captain!
I'm pretty darn mean in a fight
and there ain't nobody better than me
with a thrusting stinger tongue attack!
entries.source:
Why, heck!
Maybe I'll even make the trip to your planet!
I'd make a good starship captain, Captain!
I'm pretty darn mean in a fight
and there ain't nobody better than me
with a thrusting stinger tongue attack!
entries.translation:
哎呀！
說不定我也會去你們的行 星！
艦長，我一定能當個好星艦 艦長！
打起仗來，我可是兇得不得 了
要說用毒刺舌頭突刺攻擊
根本沒人比得上我！

entries.label: never
entries.body: What? Protect you failures? No way! You're too lame!
entries.source: What? Protect you failures? No way! You're too lame!
entries.translation: 什麼？保護你們這群失敗 者？免談！你們太遜了！

entries.label: WE_ENEMIES0
entries.body:
We have revealed ourselves to you.
We have held out our appendages to you in friendship!...
...and you have treated us like dead Zebrankys.
It takes a great deal to anger one of my species, Captain
BUT YOU HAVE JUST SUCCEEDED!
Attention Shipmates! Man the spray gun! Hoist the tongue!
PREPARE FOR BATTLE!
entries.source:
We have revealed ourselves to you.
We have held out our appendages to you in friendship!...
...and you have treated us like dead Zebrankys.
It takes a great deal to anger one of my species, Captain
BUT YOU HAVE JUST SUCCEEDED!
Attention Shipmates! Man the spray gun! Hoist the tongue!
PREPARE FOR BATTLE!
entries.translation:
我們已在你面前表明身分。
我們懷著友誼向你伸出附 肢！……
……你卻把我們當成澤布蘭 基屍體。
艦長，要讓我的物種發怒可 得費很大功夫
但你剛剛成功了！
全體船員注意！ 操作噴霧槍！舉起舌頭！
準備戰鬥！

entries.label: WE_ENEMIES1
entries.body:
Yeah.
Let's toast those creeps!
entries.source:
Yeah.
Let's toast those creeps!
entries.translation:
對。
把那些混蛋烤熟吧！

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_10
entries.body:
Coming here was pointless, human.
Our species are at war.
entries.source:
Coming here was pointless, human.
Our species are at war.
entries.translation:
來這裡毫無意義，人類。
我們的物種正在交戰。

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_11
entries.body:
Right!
Prepare to die, alien scum!
entries.source:
Right!
Prepare to die, alien scum!
entries.translation:
沒錯！
準備受死吧，外星渣滓！

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_20
entries.body: If you had allied with us, Captain
entries.source: If you had allied with us, Captain
entries.translation: 艦長，如果你當初和我們結 盟

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_21
entries.body: Which you didn't!
entries.source: Which you didn't!
entries.translation: 可是你沒有！

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_22
entries.body: We would gladly tell you what we have learned
entries.source: We would gladly tell you what we have learned
entries.translation: 我們會很樂意告訴你自己的 發現

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_23
entries.body: Which we won't!
entries.source: Which we won't!
entries.translation: 可是我們不會！

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_24
entries.body:
Regarding the two warring alien factions
the Ur-Quan and their siblings, the Kohr-Ah.
entries.source:
Regarding the two warring alien factions
the Ur-Quan and their siblings, the Kohr-Ah.
entries.translation:
也就是交戰中的兩個外星派 系
烏爾關與他們的手足克爾 阿。

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_25
entries.body: But now you'll NEVER know!
entries.source: But now you'll NEVER know!
entries.translation: 但你現在永遠也別想知道！

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_30
entries.body:
With whatever remaining forces we have
we will do our best to destroy you.
entries.source:
With whatever remaining forces we have
we will do our best to destroy you.
entries.translation:
我們會動用所有殘存的兵力
盡全力摧毀你。

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_31
entries.body: Yeah! And she means it too!
entries.source: Yeah! And she means it too!
entries.translation: 對！而且她是認真的！

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_40
entries.body:
Your villainy is beyond possible forgiveness!
We are compelled by our anger to destroy you.
entries.source:
Your villainy is beyond possible forgiveness!
We are compelled by our anger to destroy you.
entries.translation:
你的惡行絕無寬恕的可能！
憤怒迫使我們必須摧毀你。

entries.label: HOSTILE_HELLO_41
entries.body:
He's probably just gonna run away again.
The coward!
entries.source:
He's probably just gonna run away again.
The coward!
entries.translation:
他大概又要逃跑了。
膽小鬼！

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOME_HELLO_10
entries.body: Ah! It is the alien from the Chenjesu's Alliance!
entries.source: Ah! It is the alien from the Chenjesu's Alliance!
entries.translation: 啊！是那個來自陳傑蘇聯盟 的外星人！

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOME_HELLO_11
entries.body: Just look at those weapon pods on his ship.
entries.source: Just look at those weapon pods on his ship.
entries.translation: 看看他船上的那些武器莢 艙。

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOME_HELLO_12
entries.body:
We hope that during this visit
we can make clear to your species
the benefits of a mutual-assistance pact.
entries.source:
We hope that during this visit
we can make clear to your species
the benefits of a mutual-assistance pact.
entries.translation:
希望本次來訪期間
我們能向你們的物種清楚說 明
締結互助協定的好處。

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOME_HELLO_13
entries.body:
But we're also armed to the teeth
so don't try stealing our atmosphere or anything sneaky like that!
entries.source:
But we're also armed to the teeth
so don't try stealing our atmosphere or anything sneaky like that!
entries.translation:
但我們也武裝到了牙齒
所以別想偷走我們的大氣， 或搞其他鬼鬼祟祟的把戲！

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOME_HELLO_20
entries.body: Once more, the Alliance starship has returned.
entries.source: Once more, the Alliance starship has returned.
entries.translation: 聯盟星艦又回來了。

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOME_HELLO_21
entries.body: Yeah. I bet THIS is the time they try to trick us.
entries.source: Yeah. I bet THIS is the time they try to trick us.
entries.translation: 對。我敢說他們這次一定會 騙我們。

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOME_HELLO_22
entries.body: Alien Captain, do you bring word from your Leaders?
entries.source: Alien Captain, do you bring word from your Leaders?
entries.translation: 外星艦長，你帶來了領袖的 答覆嗎？

entries.label: NEUTRAL_HOME_HELLO_23
entries.body:
If he does, I bet it's something like
`Submit or be Eaten'!
entries.source:
If he does, I bet it's something like
`Submit or be Eaten'!
entries.translation:
就算帶來了，我看也只是
「臣服，否則就被吃掉」之 類的話！

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_10
entries.body: Hello friend and ally!
entries.source: Hello friend and ally!
entries.translation: 你好，朋友，也是盟友！

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_11
entries.body: Got any presents for us?
entries.source: Got any presents for us?
entries.translation: 有沒有帶禮物給我們？

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_12
entries.body: We hope your struggle against the Ur-Quan goes well!
entries.source: We hope your struggle against the Ur-Quan goes well!
entries.translation: 希望你們對抗烏爾關的戰鬥 一切順利！

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_13
entries.body: Darn! He never gives us anything.
entries.source: Darn! He never gives us anything.
entries.translation: 可惡！他從來沒送過我們任 何東西。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_20
entries.body: Welcome back to our world.
entries.source: Welcome back to our world.
entries.translation: 歡迎回到我們的世界。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_21
entries.body: Yeah, welcome back to our world!
entries.source: Yeah, welcome back to our world!
entries.translation: 對，歡迎回到我們的世界！

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_22
entries.body: I just said that.
entries.source: I just said that.
entries.translation: 我剛剛才說過。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_23
entries.body:
So? It doesn't mean I can't say it too.
Besides, you always get to talk first.
That's not fair!
entries.source:
So? It doesn't mean I can't say it too.
Besides, you always get to talk first.
That's not fair!
entries.translation:
所以呢？又不代表我不能 說。
何況總是你先開口。
這不公平！

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_24
entries.body: Sorry, that's just the way it is.
entries.source: Sorry, that's just the way it is.
entries.translation: 抱歉，事情就是這樣。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_25
entries.body: Well why?! That doesn't make sense.
entries.source: Well why?! That doesn't make sense.
entries.translation: 為什麼啦？！這根本沒道 理。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_26
entries.body:
Look, don't ask me.
I think it's something technical.
entries.source:
Look, don't ask me.
I think it's something technical.
entries.translation:
聽著，別問我。
我想是某種技術原因。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_27
entries.body:
Yeah, right. I'm so sure.
What a lame excuse.
entries.source:
Yeah, right. I'm so sure.
What a lame excuse.
entries.translation:
對啦，最好是。
真是個爛藉口。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_30
entries.body:
Greetings Captain.
What can your allies do for you?
entries.source:
Greetings Captain.
What can your allies do for you?
entries.translation:
你好，艦長。
你的盟友能為你做些什麼？

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_31
entries.body: Your favorite allies!
entries.source: Your favorite allies!
entries.translation: 是你最喜歡的盟友！

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_40
entries.body:
Hello human ally.
We are at your service.
entries.source:
Hello human ally.
We are at your service.
entries.translation:
你好，人類盟友。
我們為你服務。

entries.label: ALLIED_HOME_HELLO_41
entries.body: What do you want?
entries.source: What do you want?
entries.translation: 你想要什麼？

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE0
entries.body:
Our Savior! Our Savior!
You have rescued us from certain destruction!
entries.source:
Our Savior! Our Savior!
You have rescued us from certain destruction!
entries.translation:
我們的救星！我們的救星！
你把我們從必然毀滅的命運 中救了出來！

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE1
entries.body: Howee-baby! That was a close one!
entries.source: Howee-baby! That was a close one!
entries.translation: 好險啊，寶貝！ 真的差一點！

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE2
entries.body:
The black ship appeared in orbit several days ago
and began raining down bolts of destructive energy
on the surface of our planet!
entries.source:
The black ship appeared in orbit several days ago
and began raining down bolts of destructive energy
on the surface of our planet!
entries.translation:
那艘黑色船艦幾天前出現在 軌道上
開始朝我們的行星地表
降下毀滅能量箭雨！

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE3
entries.body: Fortunately...
entries.source: Fortunately...
entries.translation: 幸運的是……

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE4
entries.body:
...we were able to focus our planetary shields
to deflect the energy blasts away from our cities.
entries.source:
...we were able to focus our planetary shields
to deflect the energy blasts away from our cities.
entries.translation:
……我們成功集中行星護盾
讓能量攻擊偏離城市。

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE5
entries.body: Unfortunately...
entries.source: Unfortunately...
entries.translation: 不幸的是……

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE6
entries.body:
Large sections of our planet's beautiful wilderness
have been annihilated... entire ecosystems destroyed.
entries.source:
Large sections of our planet's beautiful wilderness
have been annihilated... entire ecosystems destroyed.
entries.translation:
我們行星上大片美麗的荒野
都遭到殲滅…… 整個生態系毀於一旦。

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE7
entries.body:
Oh! That makes me REALLY mad!
I mean, attacking helpless, intelligent, alien species
that's one thing,
but toasting our cute little wood Jukes and tree Narfs
that is really low!
entries.source:
Oh! That makes me REALLY mad!
I mean, attacking helpless, intelligent, alien species
that's one thing,
but toasting our cute little wood Jukes and tree Narfs
that is really low!
entries.translation:
喔！這真的讓我氣炸了！
我是說，攻擊無力還手的外 星智慧物種
那也就算了，
可是把可愛的小木丘克和樹 納夫烤焦
實在太卑鄙了！

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE8
entries.body:
If the black ship had been accompanied by others of its kind
we wouldn't have been able stop the rain of destruction.
They would have killed us all.
entries.source:
If the black ship had been accompanied by others of its kind
we wouldn't have been able stop the rain of destruction.
They would have killed us all.
entries.translation:
如果那艘黑色船艦還有其他 同類陪同
我們就無法阻止毀滅之雨。
他們會殺光我們。

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE9
entries.body: Well in that case, better those Jukes and Narfs than us, right?
entries.source: Well in that case, better those Jukes and Narfs than us, right?
entries.translation: 既然如此，被殺的是丘克和 納夫總比我們好，對吧？

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE10
entries.body:
Captain, it is clear that in matters of war
you are more capable than ourselves.
With this in mind, we would like to give you
our four finest starships and crew.
I hope they bring you many victories.
entries.source:
Captain, it is clear that in matters of war
you are more capable than ourselves.
With this in mind, we would like to give you
our four finest starships and crew.
I hope they bring you many victories.
entries.translation:
艦長，顯然在戰爭方面
你的能力勝過我們。
有鑑於此，我們想送給你
我方最優秀的四艘星艦及其 船員。
希望他們能為你帶來許多勝 利。

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_RESCUE11
entries.body: Try not to lose them all right away.
entries.source: Try not to lose them all right away.
entries.translation: 盡量別馬上就把他們全弄 丟。

entries.label: bye_homeworld
entries.body: Bye Zoq. Bye Fot. Bye Pik.
entries.source: Bye Zoq. Bye Fot. Bye Pik.
entries.translation: 再見，佐克。再見，福特。 再見，皮克。

entries.label: GOODBYE_HOME0
entries.body: Goodbye Captain.
entries.source: Goodbye Captain.
entries.translation: 再見，艦長。

entries.label: GOODBYE_HOME1
entries.body: See ya.
entries.source: See ya.
entries.translation: 回頭見。

entries.label: whats_up_homeworld
entries.body: So, what's happening around here?
entries.source: So, what's happening around here?
entries.translation: 所以，這附近有什麼新鮮 事？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_10
entries.body: We had a close call last week.
entries.source: We had a close call last week.
entries.translation: 上週我們差點大難臨頭。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_11
entries.body: One of those black ships was snooping around the system.
entries.source: One of those black ships was snooping around the system.
entries.translation: 有一艘那種黑色船艦在星系 附近鬼鬼祟祟。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_12
entries.body:
But before it got to our world
some of the Green ships warped in
destroyed the black vessel
and then left immediately.
entries.source:
But before it got to our world
some of the Green ships warped in
destroyed the black vessel
and then left immediately.
entries.translation:
但它抵達我們的世界以前
幾艘綠色船艦曲速駛入
摧毀了黑色船艦
隨後立刻離開。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_13
entries.body: We got lucky.
entries.source: We got lucky.
entries.translation: 我們走運了。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_20
entries.body:
It's been pretty quiet, Captain.
Nothing new to report.
entries.source:
It's been pretty quiet, Captain.
Nothing new to report.
entries.translation:
最近很平靜，艦長。
沒有新消息。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_21
entries.body: Are you CRAZY?! What about the Frungy Championships!?
entries.source: Are you CRAZY?! What about the Frungy Championships!?
entries.translation: 你瘋了嗎？！那弗朗吉錦標 賽呢！？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_22
entries.body:
Why should we tell the Earth Captain about that?
He wouldn't be interested.
entries.source:
Why should we tell the Earth Captain about that?
He wouldn't be interested.
entries.translation:
為什麼要跟地球艦長說那件 事？
他不會有興趣。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_23
entries.body: Oh, yeah? How do you know?
entries.source: Oh, yeah? How do you know?
entries.translation: 喔，是喔？你怎麼知道？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_24
entries.body:
Because I'M not even interested.
Nobody with any brains is interested in Frungy!
entries.source:
Because I'M not even interested.
Nobody with any brains is interested in Frungy!
entries.translation:
因為連我都沒興趣。
有腦袋的人才不會對弗朗吉 感興趣！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_25
entries.body:
Well what about me, huh?
I LOVE Frungy! It's the Sport of Kings!
entries.source:
Well what about me, huh?
I LOVE Frungy! It's the Sport of Kings!
entries.translation:
那我呢，蛤？
我最愛弗朗吉！ 那可是王者的運動！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_26
entries.body: Sheesh!
entries.source: Sheesh!
entries.translation: 真受不了！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_27
entries.body:
Oh, all right
he wouldn't know any of the teams anyway.
entries.source:
Oh, all right
he wouldn't know any of the teams anyway.
entries.translation:
喔，好吧
反正他也不認識任何隊伍。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_30
entries.body:
Although this may not pertain to the Ur-Quan
we have received an interesting report
from one of our deep space scouts.
entries.source:
Although this may not pertain to the Ur-Quan
we have received an interesting report
from one of our deep space scouts.
entries.translation:
雖然這件事可能與烏爾關無 關
但我們從一名深空偵察員那 裡
收到了一份有趣的報告。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_31
entries.body:
She found a strange metal door-thing
embedded in the surface of an alien planet.
entries.source:
She found a strange metal door-thing
embedded in the surface of an alien planet.
entries.translation:
她發現一扇奇怪的金屬門狀 物
嵌在某顆外星行星的地表。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_32
entries.body:
Although she and her crew spent many days
trying to open the door
entries.source:
Although she and her crew spent many days
trying to open the door
entries.translation:
她和船員雖然花了很多天
試圖打開那扇門

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_33
entries.body: they failed utterly to so much as budge it.
entries.source: they failed utterly to so much as budge it.
entries.translation: 卻徹底失敗，甚至無法挪動 分毫。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_34
entries.body:
The reported location of this alien artifact
is Epsilon Camelopardalis I-A.
entries.source:
The reported location of this alien artifact
is Epsilon Camelopardalis I-A.
entries.translation:
報告中那件外星神器的位置
是 Epsilon Camelopardalis I-A。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_35
entries.body:
Go open it!
I bet there's something cool inside!
entries.source:
Go open it!
I bet there's something cool inside!
entries.translation:
去打開它！
我敢說裡頭一定有很酷的東 西！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_40
entries.body:
We may not have told you this before, Captain
but my species is somewhat sensitive
to certain meta-psychic vibrations.
entries.source:
We may not have told you this before, Captain
but my species is somewhat sensitive
to certain meta-psychic vibrations.
entries.translation:
艦長，我們以前或許沒提過
但我的物種對某些超心理振 動
有些敏感。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_41
entries.body: Oh, no! Not this mental stuff again!
entries.source: Oh, no! Not this mental stuff again!
entries.translation: 喔，不！又要講那些心靈鬼 話了！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_42
entries.body:
Although my friend's species
has difficulty understanding our powers
I can guarantee you, Captain
that our limited abilities are quite real.
entries.source:
Although my friend's species
has difficulty understanding our powers
I can guarantee you, Captain
that our limited abilities are quite real.
entries.translation:
雖然我朋友的物種
很難理解我們的力量
但我可以向你保證，艦長
我們有限的能力千真萬確。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_43
entries.body:
Oh, yeah! Remember that time
you said you could fix our broken chronometers
with your `sympathetic psionic waves'?
More like `pathetic waves' if you ask me!
Nyark! Nyark! Nyark!
entries.source:
Oh, yeah! Remember that time
you said you could fix our broken chronometers
with your `sympathetic psionic waves'?
More like `pathetic waves' if you ask me!
Nyark! Nyark! Nyark!
entries.translation:
喔，是喔！還記得那次嗎
你說能用「共感靈能波」
修好我們壞掉的計時器？
要我說，根本是「可悲靈能 波」！
唔呵！唔呵！唔呵！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_44
entries.body:
Even through all this negative energy, Captain
we have discovered that...
entries.source:
Even through all this negative energy, Captain
we have discovered that...
entries.translation:
艦長，即使隔著這一大團負 面能量
我們仍發現……

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_45
entries.body:
...and THEN there was the time
you said you could bend dorfs with just your...
entries.source:
...and THEN there was the time
you said you could bend dorfs with just your...
entries.translation:
……還有那一次
你說光靠你的…… 就能彎曲多夫……

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_46
entries.body: SHUT UP!
entries.source: SHUT UP!
entries.translation: 閉嘴！

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_47
entries.body: ...sorry.
entries.source: ...sorry.
entries.translation: ……抱歉。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_48
entries.body: As I was saying, before I was so RUDELY interrupted!...
entries.source: As I was saying, before I was so RUDELY interrupted!...
entries.translation: 回到剛才說的， 還沒被人如此無禮地打斷以 前！……

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_49
entries.body: I said I was sorry.
entries.source: I said I was sorry.
entries.translation: 我說過對不起了。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_410
entries.body:
Our most talented Seers have detected
some ominous and powerful meta-psychic signals
from the direction of the Orionis constellation.
entries.source:
Our most talented Seers have detected
some ominous and powerful meta-psychic signals
from the direction of the Orionis constellation.
entries.translation:
我們最有天分的先知偵測到
某些不祥又強大的超心理訊 號
來自 Orionis 星座方向。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_411
entries.body: Faker.
entries.source: Faker.
entries.translation: 騙子。

entries.label: any_war_news
entries.body: Any news about the war between the two alien races?
entries.source: Any news about the war between the two alien races?
entries.translation: 那兩個外星種族的戰爭有新 消息嗎？

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY0
entries.body:
Our scouts have witnessed an exciting event
in the Horologii star system.
entries.source:
Our scouts have witnessed an exciting event
in the Horologii star system.
entries.translation:
我方偵察員在 Horologii 恆星系
目睹了一件令人振奮的大 事。

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY1
entries.body: Yeah! Big news!
entries.source: Yeah! Big news!
entries.translation: 對！天大的消息！

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY2
entries.body:
Two alien races have entered that region of space
from the coreward direction.
entries.source:
Two alien races have entered that region of space
from the coreward direction.
entries.translation:
有兩個外星種族從朝向核心 的方向
進入了那片星域。

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY3
entries.body:
One of the races look like big talkin' weeds
and the other wears a funny mask.
entries.source:
One of the races look like big talkin' weeds
and the other wears a funny mask.
entries.translation:
一族看起來像會說話的大雜 草
另一族則戴著好笑的面具。

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY4
entries.body: And they are attacking our enemies!
entries.source: And they are attacking our enemies!
entries.translation: 而且他們正在攻擊我們的敵 人！

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY5
entries.body: Well, ONE of our enemies, anyway.
entries.source: Well, ONE of our enemies, anyway.
entries.translation: 嗯，至少是其中一個敵人。

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY6
entries.body:
Yes, the new aliens seem to be confining their hostilities
to the sinister Kohr-Ah.
entries.source:
Yes, the new aliens seem to be confining their hostilities
to the sinister Kohr-Ah.
entries.translation:
沒錯，新來的外星人似乎把 敵對行動
限定在邪惡的克爾阿身上。

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY7
entries.body: Actually, that's good news.
entries.source: Actually, that's good news.
entries.translation: 其實這是好消息。

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY8
entries.body:
By focusing on the Kohr-Ah
who have been winning their war up to this point...
entries.source:
By focusing on the Kohr-Ah
who have been winning their war up to this point...
entries.translation:
他們集中攻擊截至目前為止
一直在戰爭中占上風的克爾 阿……

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY9
entries.body: They've been plastering the Ur-Quan.
entries.source: They've been plastering the Ur-Quan.
entries.translation: 他們一直把烏爾關打得落花 流水。

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY10
entries.body: The balance of power has been equalized somewhat...
entries.source: The balance of power has been equalized somewhat...
entries.translation: 力量平衡已經稍微拉平 了……

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY11
entries.body: But the Kohr-Ah will STILL probably win!
entries.source: But the Kohr-Ah will STILL probably win!
entries.translation: 但克爾阿多半還是會贏！

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY12
entries.body:
But we estimate that the efforts of these new alien races
has delayed the Kohr-Ah's eventual victory
by nine to twelve months.
entries.source:
But we estimate that the efforts of these new alien races
has delayed the Kohr-Ah's eventual victory
by nine to twelve months.
entries.translation:
不過據我們估計， 這些新外星種族的努力
使克爾阿最終獲勝的時間
延後了九到十二個月。

entries.label: UTWIG_DELAY13
entries.body: Still, it's better than nothing!
entries.source: Still, it's better than nothing!
entries.translation: 總比什麼都沒有好！

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING0
entries.body:
We have modified a few of our Stinger starships
for long-range reconnaissance missions.
entries.source:
We have modified a few of our Stinger starships
for long-range reconnaissance missions.
entries.translation:
我們改裝了幾艘毒刺艦
用來執行長程偵察任務。

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING1
entries.body: We strapped a bunch of fuel tanks on their hulls.
entries.source: We strapped a bunch of fuel tanks on their hulls.
entries.translation: 我們在船殼上綁了一大堆燃 料槽。

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING2
entries.body:
The scouts were ordered to investigate the progress of the war
between the green ships, who we now know as the `Ur-Quan'
and the black ships, flown by the `Kohr-Ah'.
entries.source:
The scouts were ordered to investigate the progress of the war
between the green ships, who we now know as the `Ur-Quan'
and the black ships, flown by the `Kohr-Ah'.
entries.translation:
偵察員奉命調查雙方的戰況 進展
一方是我們現在知道名為 「烏爾關」的綠色船艦
另一方則是由「克爾阿」駕 駛的黑色船艦。

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING3
entries.body: We sent out ten... two came back
entries.source: We sent out ten... two came back
entries.translation: 我們派了十艘出去…… 兩艘回來

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING4
entries.body: But the information they gathered was worth the cost.
entries.source: But the information they gathered was worth the cost.
entries.translation: 不過他們收集的情報值得這 項代價。

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING5
entries.body:
Unless you were one of the scouts, I suppose?
Nyark! Nyark! Nyark!
entries.source:
Unless you were one of the scouts, I suppose?
Nyark! Nyark! Nyark!
entries.translation:
除非你正好是其中一名偵察 員吧？
唔呵！唔呵！唔呵！

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING6
entries.body: SHUT UP!
entries.source: SHUT UP!
entries.translation: 閉嘴！

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING7
entries.body: ...sorry.
entries.source: ...sorry.
entries.translation: ……抱歉。

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING8
entries.body:
Anyway, as I was saying, the intelligence they gathered
indicates that the Kohr-Ah will win their war
sometime near the beginning of the year 2158.
entries.source:
Anyway, as I was saying, the intelligence they gathered
indicates that the Kohr-Ah will win their war
sometime near the beginning of the year 2158.
entries.translation:
總之，回到剛才的話題， 他們收集到的情報
顯示克爾阿將在 2158 年初左右
贏得這場戰爭。

entries.label: KOHRAH_WINNING9
entries.body:
Unless someone evens up the alien forces
by destroying about a bazillion Kohr-Ah ships.
entries.source:
Unless someone evens up the alien forces
by destroying about a bazillion Kohr-Ah ships.
entries.translation:
除非有人摧毀多到數不清的 克爾阿船艦
讓外星雙方勢力恢復平衡。

entries.label: URQUAN_NEARLY_GONE0
entries.body: Our reconnaissance ships have returned once more
entries.source: Our reconnaissance ships have returned once more
entries.translation: 我們的偵察船又回來了

entries.label: URQUAN_NEARLY_GONE1
entries.body: With bad news.
entries.source: With bad news.
entries.translation: 帶著壞消息。

entries.label: URQUAN_NEARLY_GONE2
entries.body:
Based on what they have seen
the Kohr-Ah will defeat the Ur-Quan
in less than six months.
entries.source:
Based on what they have seen
the Kohr-Ah will defeat the Ur-Quan
in less than six months.
entries.translation:
根據他們的觀察
克爾阿將在不到六個月內
擊敗烏爾關。

entries.label: URQUAN_NEARLY_GONE3
entries.body: Bummer.
entries.source: Bummer.
entries.translation: 真慘。

entries.label: URQUAN_NEARLY_GONE4
entries.body:
And based on our last encounter with the Kohr-Ah
we expect that when they win their war with the Ur-Quan
the Kohr-Ah will move through this entire region of space
destroying all intelligent life.
entries.source:
And based on our last encounter with the Kohr-Ah
we expect that when they win their war with the Ur-Quan
the Kohr-Ah will move through this entire region of space
destroying all intelligent life.
entries.translation:
根據我們上次與克爾阿接觸 的情況
我們預期克爾阿打贏對烏爾 關的戰爭後
便會掃過整片星域
摧毀一切智慧生命。

entries.label: URQUAN_NEARLY_GONE5
entries.body: Major bummer!
entries.source: Major bummer!
entries.translation: 慘透了！

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY0
entries.body: I fear we have received our last scouting reports, Captain.
entries.source: I fear we have received our last scouting reports, Captain.
entries.translation: 艦長，恐怕這是我們收到的 最後一批偵察報告。

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY1
entries.body: Poor Yip, Tun and Haffy! I'll really miss those guys!
entries.source: Poor Yip, Tun and Haffy! I'll really miss those guys!
entries.translation: 可憐的伊普、頓和哈菲！ 我真的會想念那些傢伙！

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY2
entries.body: Although none of our scouts returned home alive
entries.source: Although none of our scouts returned home alive
entries.translation: 儘管沒有任何偵察員活著回 到家

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY3
entries.body:
...and Jiff... and Fod... and (sniff!)...
...and my best pal, Rogi!
entries.source:
...and Jiff... and Fod... and (sniff!)...
...and my best pal, Rogi!
entries.translation:
……還有吉夫……福德…… 還有（吸鼻子！）……
……以及我最要好的朋友羅 吉！

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY4
entries.body:
They were able to send a last message.
The Kohr-Ah have won their war against the Ur-Quan
and they have begun their hideous death march.
entries.source:
They were able to send a last message.
The Kohr-Ah have won their war against the Ur-Quan
and they have begun their hideous death march.
entries.translation:
他們成功送出了最後一道訊 息。
克爾阿已贏得對烏爾關的戰 爭
並開始那場恐怖的死亡行 軍。

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY5
entries.body: (sniff!)
entries.source: (sniff!)
entries.translation: （吸鼻子！）

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY6
entries.body:
The only piece of knowledge we have
that may help you defeat them
is a fragment of a transmission we received
from our agent Buppo who was in the Crateris constellation.
entries.source:
The only piece of knowledge we have
that may help you defeat them
is a fragment of a transmission we received
from our agent Buppo who was in the Crateris constellation.
entries.translation:
我們唯一掌握的資訊
或許能幫助你擊敗他們
那是我們從派往 Crateris 星座的特工布波那裡
收到的一段殘缺通訊。

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY7
entries.body: They got Buppo too?!...(SOB!)
entries.source: They got Buppo too?!...(SOB!)
entries.translation: 他們連布波也抓到 了？！……（大哭！）

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY8
entries.body:
He reported that the Kohr-Ah had something
`big, dangerous and important as hell'
in one of the nearby star systems.
That was all we got before Buppo's signal was cut off.
entries.source:
He reported that the Kohr-Ah had something
`big, dangerous and important as hell'
in one of the nearby star systems.
That was all we got before Buppo's signal was cut off.
entries.translation:
他報告說，克爾阿擁有某個
「大得嚇人、危險得要命， 而且重要到不得了」的東西
就在附近某個恆星系。
然後布波的訊號就中斷了， 我們只收到這些。

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY9
entries.body: (SOB!)
entries.source: (SOB!)
entries.translation: （大哭！）

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY10
entries.body:
You have got to stop the Kohr-Ah, Captain!...
...before they kill us all.
entries.source:
You have got to stop the Kohr-Ah, Captain!...
...before they kill us all.
entries.translation:
艦長，你一定得阻止克爾 阿！……
……在他們殺光我們以前。

entries.label: KOHRAH_FRENZY11
entries.body: (sniff!)
entries.source: (sniff!)
entries.translation: （吸鼻子！）

entries.label: NO_WAR_NEWS0
entries.body: No. We have nothing new to report.
entries.source: No. We have nothing new to report.
entries.translation: 沒有。我們沒有新消息。

entries.label: NO_WAR_NEWS1
entries.body: Nope! Not a thing.
entries.source: Nope! Not a thing.
entries.translation: 沒有！半點都沒有。

entries.label: i_want_alliance
entries.body: I have travelled here to seek an alliance between our peoples.
entries.source: I have travelled here to seek an alliance between our peoples.
entries.translation: 我遠道而來，想尋求雙方人 民締結同盟。

entries.label: GOOD0
entries.body: How wonderful! We accept!
entries.source: How wonderful! We accept!
entries.translation: 太美好了！我們接受！

entries.label: GOOD1
entries.body: Hurray!
entries.source: Hurray!
entries.translation: 萬歲！

entries.label: GOOD2
entries.body: How marvelous!
entries.source: How marvelous!
entries.translation: 真是太棒了！

entries.label: GOOD3
entries.body: Yee-ha!
entries.source: Yee-ha!
entries.translation: 耶－哈！

entries.label: GOOD4
entries.body: Captain, we are delighted that your people have made this choice!
entries.source: Captain, we are delighted that your people have made this choice!
entries.translation: 艦長，我們很高興你們的人 民作出這項選擇！

entries.label: GOOD5
entries.body: Now WE won't get slaughtered!
entries.source: Now WE won't get slaughtered!
entries.translation: 這下我們不會慘遭屠殺了！

entries.label: GOOD6
entries.body:
In exchange for our cooperation helping you with captains and ship designs
all that we ask for is your protection.
entries.source:
In exchange for our cooperation helping you with captains and ship designs
all that we ask for is your protection.
entries.translation:
作為我們提供艦長與船艦設 計協助你們的交換條件
唯一的要求就是你們保護我 們。

entries.label: GOOD7
entries.body: So we don't get slaughtered!
entries.source: So we don't get slaughtered!
entries.translation: 讓我們不會慘遭屠殺！

entries.label: GOOD8
entries.body:
We shall begin fulfilling our commitment at once!
We will transport officers and our Stinger design to your base immediately!
entries.source:
We shall begin fulfilling our commitment at once!
We will transport officers and our Stinger design to your base immediately!
entries.translation:
我們會立刻開始履行承諾！
馬上把軍官與毒刺艦設計送 往你們的基地！

entries.label: GOOD9
entries.body:
Why, heck!
Maybe I'll even make the trip to your planet!
I'd make a good starship captain, Captain!
I'm pretty darn mean in a fight
and there ain't nobody better than me
with a thrusting stinger tongue attack!
entries.source:
Why, heck!
Maybe I'll even make the trip to your planet!
I'd make a good starship captain, Captain!
I'm pretty darn mean in a fight
and there ain't nobody better than me
with a thrusting stinger tongue attack!
entries.translation:
哎呀！
說不定我也會去你們的行 星！
艦長，我一定能當個好星艦 艦長！
打起仗來，我可是兇得不得 了
要說用毒刺舌頭突刺攻擊
根本沒人比得上我！

entries.label: want_specific_info
entries.body: I would like some specific information.
entries.source: I would like some specific information.
entries.translation: 我想知道幾項特定資訊。

entries.label: WHAT_SPECIFIC_INFO0
entries.body: Sure. What do you want to know?
entries.source: Sure. What do you want to know?
entries.translation: 當然。你想知道什麼？

entries.label: WHAT_SPECIFIC_INFO1
entries.body: Just ask away!
entries.source: Just ask away!
entries.translation: 儘管問吧！

entries.label: enough_info
entries.body: That's enough info for now, thanks!
entries.source: That's enough info for now, thanks!
entries.translation: 目前知道這些就夠了， 謝謝！

entries.label: OK_ENOUGH_INFO
entries.body: Anything else?
entries.source: Anything else?
entries.translation: 還有別的嗎？

entries.label: what_about_others
entries.body: What do you know about other alien races?
entries.source: What do you know about other alien races?
entries.translation: 你們對其他外星種族知道多 少？

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS0
entries.body: Not much, to tell the truth.
entries.source: Not much, to tell the truth.
entries.translation: 老實說，知道得不多。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS1
entries.body: This space exploration stuff is kinda new to us.
entries.source: This space exploration stuff is kinda new to us.
entries.translation: 探索太空這回事， 我們才剛起步。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS2
entries.body: Besides the green alien ships...
entries.source: Besides the green alien ships...
entries.translation: 除了綠色外星船艦……

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS3
entries.body: Which have only tried to kill us.
entries.source: Which have only tried to kill us.
entries.translation: 他們只企圖殺掉我們。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS4
entries.body: ...and the black alien ships...
entries.source: ...and the black alien ships...
entries.translation: ……以及黑色外星船艦……

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS5
entries.body: Which have actually been QUITE SUCCESSFUL at killing us.
entries.source: Which have actually been QUITE SUCCESSFUL at killing us.
entries.translation: 他們真的非常成功地殺掉了 很多我們的人。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS6
entries.body:
The only other starships we have encountered
are strange tumbling red probes
which profess to be on a peaceful mission...
entries.source:
The only other starships we have encountered
are strange tumbling red probes
which profess to be on a peaceful mission...
entries.translation:
我們遇過的其他星艦
就只有翻滾著飛行的奇怪紅 色探測器
它們聲稱正在執行和平任 務……

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS7
entries.body: ...but then attack like slavering Zebrankys.
entries.source: ...but then attack like slavering Zebrankys.
entries.translation: ……隨後卻像流口水的澤布 蘭基一樣發動攻擊。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS8
entries.body:
We believe that the probes are actually robotic scouts
which have suffered some kind of malfunction
resulting in their aberrant behavior.
entries.source:
We believe that the probes are actually robotic scouts
which have suffered some kind of malfunction
resulting in their aberrant behavior.
entries.translation:
我們相信那些探測器其實是 機器人偵察器
發生了某種故障
才導致異常行為。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS9
entries.body: And what's worse, they are multiplying.
entries.source: And what's worse, they are multiplying.
entries.translation: 更糟的是，它們還會繁殖。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS10
entries.body:
Yes, that's true.
The probes seem to be replicating at a geometric rate.
entries.source:
Yes, that's true.
The probes seem to be replicating at a geometric rate.
entries.translation:
沒錯，確實如此。
探測器似乎正以等比速率複 製。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS11
entries.body:
AIEE! That means if there was only one last week
then next month... ah
wait a minute... let me calculate
uh
That means, next month there will be
...A WHOLE MESS OF THOSE THINGS!
entries.source:
AIEE! That means if there was only one last week
then next month... ah
wait a minute... let me calculate
uh
That means, next month there will be
...A WHOLE MESS OF THOSE THINGS!
entries.translation:
啊咿！也就是說， 如果上週只有一具
那麼下個月……呃
等等……讓我算一下
嗯
也就是說，下個月會有
……一大票那種東西！

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS12
entries.body:
By back-tracing the probes' course paths
we have been able to calculate
that the source of the probes
is somewhere on a direct line
that includes our star, and Epsilon Muscae.
entries.source:
By back-tracing the probes' course paths
we have been able to calculate
that the source of the probes
is somewhere on a direct line
that includes our star, and Epsilon Muscae.
entries.translation:
透過反向追蹤探測器的航線
我們成功計算出
探測器的來源
位於一條直線上的某處
而那條線包含我們的恆星與 Epsilon Muscae。

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHERS13
entries.body: Go get 'em, Captain!
entries.source: Go get 'em, Captain!
entries.translation: 艦長，去收拾它們！

entries.label: what_about_zebranky
entries.body: Tell me more about your people.
entries.source: Tell me more about your people.
entries.translation: 再多告訴我一些你們人民的 事。

entries.label: ABOUT_ZEBRANKY0
entries.body: Ah! Cultural exchange. A good idea.
entries.source: Ah! Cultural exchange. A good idea.
entries.translation: 啊！文化交流。好主意。

entries.label: ABOUT_ZEBRANKY1
entries.body: Yeah! Let's tell him about Frungy!
entries.source: Yeah! Let's tell him about Frungy!
entries.translation: 對！告訴他弗朗吉的事吧！

entries.label: ABOUT_ZEBRANKY2
entries.body:
Be quiet, you fool! He asked a serious question!
He doesn't want to know about Frungy.
entries.source:
Be quiet, you fool! He asked a serious question!
He doesn't want to know about Frungy.
entries.translation:
安靜，你這蠢蛋！ 他問的是嚴肅問題！
他才不想知道弗朗吉。

entries.label: ABOUT_ZEBRANKY3
entries.body:
How do you know? What makes you so smart?
You never even asked him if he wants to know about Frungy.
Why, I'll bet right now he's wondering
`What is this wonderful sport, Frungy?', `How is it played?'
`What kind of equipment do you need to play Frungy?'
and `I wonder who's ahead in the Frungy Championships?'
entries.source:
How do you know? What makes you so smart?
You never even asked him if he wants to know about Frungy.
Why, I'll bet right now he's wondering
`What is this wonderful sport, Frungy?', `How is it played?'
`What kind of equipment do you need to play Frungy?'
and `I wonder who's ahead in the Frungy Championships?'
entries.translation:
你怎麼知道？你憑什麼那麼 聰明？
你甚至沒問過他想不想知道 弗朗吉。
我敢說他現在正在想
「弗朗吉這項精彩運動究竟 是什麼？」、「玩法如 何？」
「玩弗朗吉需要什麼器 材？」
以及「不知道誰在弗朗吉錦 標賽中領先？」

entries.label: ABOUT_ZEBRANKY4
entries.body:
AUGH! Will you SHUT UP ABOUT FRUNGY?!
If you say another word about that STUPID GAME
I'm going to lose control and blow a cloud of spores at you!
entries.source:
AUGH! Will you SHUT UP ABOUT FRUNGY?!
If you say another word about that STUPID GAME
I'm going to lose control and blow a cloud of spores at you!
entries.translation:
啊啊！你能不能別再講弗朗 吉了？！
你再多說一個字提到那個蠢 遊戲
我就要失控，朝你噴出一團 孢子！

entries.label: ABOUT_ZEBRANKY5
entries.body:
Yech! Okay, okay. Don't blow your sac.
I won't mention Frungy again, I promise.
entries.source:
Yech! Okay, okay. Don't blow your sac.
I won't mention Frungy again, I promise.
entries.translation:
噁！好啦、好啦。 別氣炸你的囊袋。
我不會再提弗朗吉了， 保證。

entries.label: ABOUT_ZEBRANKY6
entries.body:
Well, Captain, as you can probably see
our culture's predominant trait
its greatest strength AND weakness
is the diverse interactions between Zoq, Fot, and Pik.
entries.source:
Well, Captain, as you can probably see
our culture's predominant trait
its greatest strength AND weakness
is the diverse interactions between Zoq, Fot, and Pik.
entries.translation:
艦長，你大概看得出來
我們文化最鮮明的特質
也是最大的優點與缺點
就是佐克、福特和皮克之間 多樣的互動。

entries.label: ABOUT_ZEBRANKY7
entries.body: FRUNGY! FRUNGY! FRUNGY!
entries.source: FRUNGY! FRUNGY! FRUNGY!
entries.translation: 弗朗吉！弗朗吉！弗朗吉！

entries.label: what_about_past
entries.body: What was your history like?
entries.source: What was your history like?
entries.translation: 你們的歷史是什麼樣子？

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST0
entries.body:
Our past? Quite a broad topic for this short conversation
but we'll share a key piece of our history with you.
entries.source:
Our past? Quite a broad topic for this short conversation
but we'll share a key piece of our history with you.
entries.translation:
我們的過去？對這場短暫交 談而言，主題相當廣泛
不過可以與你分享其中一段 重要歷史。

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST1
entries.body:
After we killed off the last Zebranky
we faced an interesting question.
entries.source:
After we killed off the last Zebranky
we faced an interesting question.
entries.translation:
殺掉最後一隻澤布蘭基後
我們面臨了一個有趣的問 題。

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST2
entries.body:
Should we proceed, and establish a culture
which would advance in art, technology and social sophistication?...
entries.source:
Should we proceed, and establish a culture
which would advance in art, technology and social sophistication?...
entries.translation:
我們該繼續前進，建立一種
在藝術、科技與社會精緻度 上不斷進步的文化嗎？……

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST3
entries.body:
...Or should we just go back into the forest
and kick back and enjoy ourselves
knowing that a Zebranky wasn't gonna jump out of the bush and eat us!
entries.source:
...Or should we just go back into the forest
and kick back and enjoy ourselves
knowing that a Zebranky wasn't gonna jump out of the bush and eat us!
entries.translation:
……還是直接回到森林
輕鬆享受生活
因為再也不用擔心澤布蘭基 突然從草叢跳出來吃掉我 們！

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST4
entries.body:
Well, we DID go back into the forest.
We stayed there for about five thousand years and had a great time...
entries.source:
Well, we DID go back into the forest.
We stayed there for about five thousand years and had a great time...
entries.translation:
嗯，我們的確回到了森林。
在那裡待了大約五千年， 過得非常快樂……

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST5
entries.body:
...then, one stormy day, a Zoq, a Fot, and a Pik were walking up a steep path
looking for something good to eat, when a bolt of lightning struck nearby.
With a huge flash of light, the bolt of energy
carved a strangely-shaped chunk of granite out of a cliff.
entries.source:
...then, one stormy day, a Zoq, a Fot, and a Pik were walking up a steep path
looking for something good to eat, when a bolt of lightning struck nearby.
With a huge flash of light, the bolt of energy
carved a strangely-shaped chunk of granite out of a cliff.
entries.translation:
……後來在某個暴風雨天， 一個佐克、一個福特和一個 皮克走上一條陡峭小徑
尋找好吃的東西， 這時一道閃電擊中附近。
伴隨著巨大閃光，能量束
從懸崖劈下一塊形狀奇特的 花崗岩。

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST6
entries.body:
It was a disk, with a hole in the middle!
As the rock began to roll down the hill, toward the three terrified beings
some dry grass got caught in its hole, and since the rock was still hot
the grass caught on fire.
entries.source:
It was a disk, with a hole in the middle!
As the rock began to roll down the hill, toward the three terrified beings
some dry grass got caught in its hole, and since the rock was still hot
the grass caught on fire.
entries.translation:
那是一個圓盤， 中間還有個洞！
岩石開始朝三個嚇壞的生物 滾下山坡時
一些乾草卡進洞裡， 而岩石仍然很燙
於是乾草著火了。

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST7
entries.body:
When the rock finally got to the Zoq, the Fot, and the Pik
they simultaneously discovered the Wheel, Fire, and Religion
thus catapulting them on to the road of progress.
entries.source:
When the rock finally got to the Zoq, the Fot, and the Pik
they simultaneously discovered the Wheel, Fire, and Religion
thus catapulting them on to the road of progress.
entries.translation:
岩石終於滾到佐克、 福特與皮克面前時
他們同時發現了輪子、 火焰和宗教
就此被彈上進步之路。

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST8
entries.body:
Which has led us to this day, Captain.
Oh! How did the flaming wheel give religion to our Culture, you ask?
entries.source:
Which has led us to this day, Captain.
Oh! How did the flaming wheel give religion to our Culture, you ask?
entries.translation:
而這條路引領我們走到今 天，艦長。
喔！你問燃燒的輪子如何為 我們的文化帶來宗教嗎？

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST9
entries.body:
I will explain.
You see, when it got to the threesome, the flaming wheel was going at a pretty good clip
and it ran smack into the Zoq, killing him.
entries.source:
I will explain.
You see, when it got to the threesome, the flaming wheel was going at a pretty good clip
and it ran smack into the Zoq, killing him.
entries.translation:
我來解釋。
你瞧，燃燒的輪子滾到那三 個生物面前時速度很快
正面撞上佐克， 把他撞死了。

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST10
entries.body:
The Fot and the Pik felt so bad
they really liked that Zoq!...
...that they decided the Zoq hadn't really died when the wheel flattened him
he had just gone to `a better place.'
entries.source:
The Fot and the Pik felt so bad
they really liked that Zoq!...
...that they decided the Zoq hadn't really died when the wheel flattened him
he had just gone to `a better place.'
entries.translation:
福特和皮克難過極了
他們真的很喜歡那個佐 克！……
……因此決定， 佐克被輪子壓扁時並沒有真 的死
只是去了「更美好的地 方」。

entries.label: ABOUT_PAST11
entries.body: Presumably one without lethal flaming wheels.
entries.source: Presumably one without lethal flaming wheels.
entries.translation: 想必是個沒有致命燃燒輪子 的地方。

entries.label: what_about_stinger
entries.body: Can you describe your `Stinger' starship?
entries.source: Can you describe your `Stinger' starship?
entries.translation: 你能描述一下你們的毒刺艦 嗎？

entries.label: ABOUT_STINGER0
entries.body: The Stinger is the peak of our technological prowess.
entries.source: The Stinger is the peak of our technological prowess.
entries.translation: 毒刺艦是我們科技實力的巔 峰。

entries.label: ABOUT_STINGER1
entries.body: It's totally awesome!
entries.source: It's totally awesome!
entries.translation: 簡直帥呆了！

entries.label: ABOUT_STINGER2
entries.body:
These vessels are cheap to build
and can be quite effective in short range combat.
entries.source:
These vessels are cheap to build
and can be quite effective in short range combat.
entries.translation:
這種船艦造價低廉
在近距離戰鬥中相當有效。

entries.label: ABOUT_STINGER3
entries.body:
They turn on a... on a
well a small round thing that's REAL small!
entries.source:
They turn on a... on a
well a small round thing that's REAL small!
entries.translation:
它們可以在一個……一個， 嗯
一個真的小得不得了的小圓 東西上轉彎！

entries.label: ABOUT_STINGER4
entries.body:
Remember though, against most ships
the Stinger must close distance immediately
and give unrelenting tongue attacks
until either the enemy or the Stinger are destroyed.
entries.source:
Remember though, against most ships
the Stinger must close distance immediately
and give unrelenting tongue attacks
until either the enemy or the Stinger are destroyed.
entries.translation:
但請記住，面對大多數船艦 時
毒刺艦必須立刻拉近距離
不停用舌頭發動攻擊
直到敵人或毒刺艦其中一方 遭到摧毀。

entries.label: ABOUT_STINGER5
entries.body: Yeah! The tonguing is the best part!
entries.source: Yeah! The tonguing is the best part!
entries.translation: 對！用舌頭才是最棒的部 分！

entries.label: what_about_guy_in_back
entries.body: Does that guy in back ever say anything?
entries.source: Does that guy in back ever say anything?
entries.translation: 後面那個傢伙有說過話嗎？

entries.label: ABOUT_GUY0
entries.body: Nope.
entries.source: Nope.
entries.translation: 沒有。

entries.label: ABOUT_GUY1
entries.body: Not a word.
entries.source: Not a word.
entries.translation: 一個字也沒有。

entries.label: name_1
entries.body: The New Alliance of Free Stars'
entries.source: The New Alliance of Free Stars'
entries.translation: 新自由星辰聯盟的

entries.label: name_2
entries.body: The Concordance of Alien Nations'
entries.source: The Concordance of Alien Nations'
entries.translation: 外星國族協約的

entries.label: name_3
entries.body: The United Federation of Worlds'
entries.source: The United Federation of Worlds'
entries.translation: 世界聯合聯邦的

entries.label: name_40
entries.body: The Empire of
entries.source: The Empire of
entries.translation: 帝國

entries.label: name_41
entries.body: 's
entries.source: 's
entries.translation: 的

entries.label: OUT_TAKES0
entries.body: Thank you for playing The Ur-Quan Masters.
entries.source: Thank you for playing The Ur-Quan Masters.
entries.translation: 感謝遊玩《烏爾關霸主》。

entries.label: OUT_TAKES1
entries.body:
This game has been brought to you by
Frungy! The Sport of Kings!
entries.source:
This game has been brought to you by
Frungy! The Sport of Kings!
entries.translation:
本遊戲由以下單位為您呈現
弗朗吉！王者的運動！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES2
entries.body: No it wasn't!
entries.source: No it wasn't!
entries.translation: 才不是！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES3
entries.body: Yes it was!
entries.source: Yes it was!
entries.translation: 就是！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES4
entries.body:
Frungy had nothing to do with it!
This game was about war, slavery, intolerance
heroism, justice, and the inevitable triumph of Good over Evil!
entries.source:
Frungy had nothing to do with it!
This game was about war, slavery, intolerance
heroism, justice, and the inevitable triumph of Good over Evil!
entries.translation:
弗朗吉跟這件事一點關係也 沒有！
本遊戲講的是戰爭、奴役、 排斥異己
英雄主義、正義， 以及善良終將戰勝邪惡！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES5
entries.body: Are you crazy?! The developers got millions in Frungy endorsements!
entries.source: Are you crazy?! The developers got millions in Frungy endorsements!
entries.translation: 你瘋了嗎？！開發者拿了好 幾百萬的弗朗吉代言費！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES6
entries.body: No they didn't.
entries.source: No they didn't.
entries.translation: 才沒有。

entries.label: OUT_TAKES7
entries.body: Yes they did.
entries.source: Yes they did.
entries.translation: 明明就有。

entries.label: OUT_TAKES8
entries.body: No they didn't!
entries.source: No they didn't!
entries.translation: 才沒有！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES9
entries.body: Yes they did!
entries.source: Yes they did!
entries.translation: 明明就有！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES10
entries.body: Did not!
entries.source: Did not!
entries.translation: 才沒有！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES11
entries.body: Did too!
entries.source: Did too!
entries.translation: 就是有！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES12
entries.body: Did not!
entries.source: Did not!
entries.translation: 才沒有！

entries.label: OUT_TAKES13
entries.body: Did too!
entries.source: Did too!
entries.translation: 就是有！
